caseNote: Each Block, the Hosting construct and the custom Block, alone on the "backend" template of create-blocks-app 1.0.1 with default options and the production preset (BlocksPresets.production, what npm run deploy synthesizes), counted as resources added to a no-Blocks baseline.

hosting.note: Default CloudFront front door with a one-page static site; the Hosting construct goes in cdk-blocks/index.cdk.ts, takes the stack rather than the scope, and the templates leave it out of a plain sandbox.

housebucket.note: A custom Block, built on FileBucket, from a package in the app's workspace. These counts are with all four standards on.

database.note: Synthesized with no options: a serverless SQL database, and 20 resources that run schema migrations at deploy. Both presets give 21, and production also retains the database and turns on deletion protection.

auth.tagline: Sign-up and sign-in backed by a managed user directory
auth.note: Auth with default options: email and password sign-in on a managed user directory. Of its 13 resources, 9 are the deploy-time guard for that directory. The sandbox preset gives 21.

hosting.note: Default content delivery network front door with a one-page static site; the Hosting construct goes in cdk-blocks/index.cdk.ts, takes the stack rather than the scope, and the templates leave it out of a plain sandbox.
